svg.aria-label: kobobridge demo, a replay of a terminal session
svg.title: kobobridge 0.2.0 demo: made-up library, stand-in servers, test key
svg.text: # kobobridge 0.2.0: made-up library, stand-in servers, test key.
# Free part: the whole Audiobookshelf library goes to the eReader.
# Run the bridge. Below, a test client makes the main requests an eReader makes on sync.
Point the eReader at this bridge:
1. Plug the eReader into a computer over USB.
2. Open the hidden folder .kobo/Kobo/ and edit 'Kobo eReader.conf'.
4. Eject, then sync from the eReader.

# On the eReader: 6 books, the whole library.
# Paid part: sync one Audiobookshelf collection instead of the whole library.
# Without a key, the bridge says why and keeps syncing everything.
syncing the whole library, collection not applied: set KOBOBRIDGE_LICENSE_KEY to the key you received
Collection: syncing the whole library, collection not applied: set KOBOBRIDGE_LICENSE_KEY to the key you
# With a key. Here a test key and a stand-in key server: the released 0.2.0 accepts no key until sales
Collection: syncing collection col_summer, key bought by Demo Buyer.
# The key was checked online once (2 requests). Later starts read a local file.
# Run the bridge again; the eReader syncs.
2026-10-02T00:28:45 INFO syncing collection col_summer, key bought by Demo Buyer
Point the eReader at this bridge:
1. Plug the eReader into a computer over USB.
2. Open the hidden folder .kobo/Kobo/ and edit 'Kobo eReader.conf'.
4. Eject, then sync from the eReader.

# This sync sends only the 2 books of the collection. No new key check.
# Whole library sync stays free, MIT. The key is 15 EUR, paid once, no subscription.
